When Linguistic and Internal Confidence Diverge in Large Language Models

Hefan Zhang Affiliation: Dartmouth College    Bingquan Zhang Affiliation: Dartmouth College    Ming Cheng Affiliation: Dartmouth College    Saeed Hassanpour Affiliation: Dartmouth College    Weicheng Ma Affiliation: Oakland University {hefan.zhang.gr,soroush.vosoughi}@dartmouth.edu    Soroush Vosoughi Affiliation: Dartmouth College
Abstract

Users often ask large language models (LLMs) to report how confident they are, but it is unclear whether such linguistic confidence tracks the model’s internal confidence. We study this question across 8 classification tasks, 2 generation tasks and 30 models from three families. For classification, we compare linguistic confidence with logits-based confidence along three axes: association, magnitude agreement and calibration. For generation, we test whether linguistic confidence tracks semantic-entropy-based uncertainty. The axes frequently diverge. Instance-level association is weak on average, although it improves on easier items and for stronger base models. Instruction-tuned models often report higher confidence and sometimes show higher association, but they also have larger confidence gaps and worse calibration. Prompt design mostly changes the distribution of reported confidence. Attitude cues inflate confidence without improving alignment, while score exemplars can preserve rank-order signal when they avoid collapsed confidence values. Regression analyses show that distributional properties of confidence scores explain much of the observed alignment pattern, with model metadata playing a smaller role after controls. These results support a lossy-channel view of linguistic confidence. A more dispersed verbal confidence distribution can carry useful rank information, but it does not make the scores calibrated. Linguistic confidence should therefore be evaluated with multi-axis diagnostics before being used in downstream reliability pipelines.

1 Introduction

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only for their answers, but also for confidence signals that help decide when an answer should be trusted, filtered, abstained from, or combined with other samples Geng et al. (2023); Liu et al. (2025). Internal signals such as token-level probabilities can support confidence-weighted voting, selective prediction and test-time selection Fu et al. (2025). In many deployed systems, however, these internal signals are not available. Users and practitioners are left with linguistic confidence, the model’s self-reported confidence in language or as a numeric score.

Prior work has shown that verbalized confidence is fragile. It can be sensitive to prompting and often becomes overconfident after instruction tuning Mielke et al. (2022); Xiong et al. (2023); Groot and Valdenegro-Toro (2024); Xu et al. (2025). Much of this work evaluates confidence as an estimator of correctness. This is important, but it leaves a separate question open. When a model says it is confident, is that statement aligned with the model’s own internal probability signal, or is it a separate user-facing behavior?

We study this cross-channel question. Our goal is not to treat logits-based confidence as ground-truth uncertainty. Softmax probabilities are themselves imperfect and often miscalibrated. Instead, we use them as an internally accessible confidence channel and ask when linguistic confidence agrees with that channel. For generation tasks, where answer-token probabilities are not always well defined, we use semantic entropy as the internal uncertainty proxy Kuhn et al. (2023).

We evaluate linguistic confidence along three axes. Association measures whether linguistic and internal confidence move together across instances. Magnitude agreement measures whether the two scores are close on a common scale. Calibration measures whether reported confidence agrees with empirical correctness. These axes are not interchangeable. A model can have high association while still being overconfident, or it can have small average distance while carrying little instance-level information.

Across 10 tasks and 30 models, we find that instance-level association is weak on average. At the same time, the weakness is structured rather than random. Easier tasks and stronger base models tend to show higher association. Instruction-tuned models often report higher confidence, but their apparent gains in association do not reliably produce better calibration. Prompt changes also have limited leverage. They can shift the mean and variance of linguistic confidence, but attitude cues that raise verbal confidence do not make it more grounded in internal probabilities.

The main empirical pattern is distributional. When linguistic confidence collapses into a narrow range, often near high values, it cannot express instance-level differences. When it is more dispersed, it can preserve rank-order information and improve association. This does not mean that more dispersion fixes calibration. The same dispersion that helps correlation can also increase magnitude mismatch if the scores are shifted or nonlinear. We therefore interpret linguistic confidence as a lossy channel from internal confidence to user-facing text. The channel can carry useful rank signal in some regimes, but it should not be read as a calibrated probability without validation.

This paper makes three contributions. We provide a systematic cross-channel evaluation of linguistic and internal confidence across model families, tasks and prompting regimes. We show that association, magnitude agreement and calibration diverge in important cases, especially for instruction-tuned models. We identify distributional properties of confidence scores as dominant observable drivers of alignment and translate this finding into practical guidance for reliability pipelines. Code is available at https://github.com/HF-heaven/Correlation-between-Confidence-Measurements.

2 Related Work

Uncertainty estimation in LLMs.

Confidence and uncertainty estimation are central to reliable LLM deployment Huang et al. (2024); Liu et al. (2025). Existing methods can be grouped into logits-based, linguistic and consistency-based approaches Geng et al. (2023). Logits-based methods use white-box access to output distributions, including softmax probabilities, entropy or logit margins Duan et al. (2023); Kuhn et al. (2023); Huang et al. (2023). Linguistic methods ask the model to express confidence directly in words or scores Mielke et al. (2022); Xiong et al. (2023). Consistency-based methods estimate uncertainty from output stability under sampling or perturbation Manakul et al. (2023); Lin et al. (2023). These signals differ in access requirements and in what part of the model behavior they measure.

Verbalized and internal confidence.

Prior work studies both the calibration of verbalized confidence and its relationship to internal uncertainty. Xiong et al. (2023); Groot and Valdenegro-Toro (2024) show that linguistic confidence can be overconfident and prompt-sensitive. Some other studies connect language-model confidence to human confidence or propose calibration interventions for verbalized scores Mielke et al. (2022); Xu et al. (2025). These studies usually judge confidence by its relationship to correctness, often through ECE, AUROC, or related calibration metrics. Lin et al. (2022) examine whether models can express calibrated uncertainty in words, while Tian et al. (2023) compare verbalized scores with conditional probabilities in models fine-tuned with human feedback. Kumar et al. (2024) directly study confidence-probability alignment using elicited certainty scores and token probabilities. Yona et al. (2024) evaluate whether linguistic hedging faithfully reflects intrinsic uncertainty. Most closely related to our generation setting, Ji et al. (2025) analyze mismatch between verbal and semantic uncertainty and use it to predict hallucinations. More broadly, the sensitivity of LLM behavior to linguistic framing Tian et al. (2026) raises questions about whether expressed confidence remains aligned with internal confidence across settings.

我们的工作通过对 30 个模型、10 个任务、分类和生成设置以及多种提示机制进行系统性多轴分析来扩展该文献。我们没有将跨渠道相关性视为校准，而是报告了两个单独的测量：关联描述了语言置信度和所选内部代理之间的一致性，而校准则根据正确性评估置信度。两种测量都可以实现另一种测量。我们还研究了任务难度、模型属性、提示和置信度分布与这些结果之间的关系。Our work extends this literature through a systematic multi-axis analysis across 30 models, 10 tasks, classification and generation settings, and multiple prompting regimes. Rather than treating cross-channel correlation as calibration, we report two separate measurements: association describes agreement between linguistic confidence and the selected internal proxy, whereas calibration evaluates confidence against correctness. Neither measurement enables the other. We additionally examine how task difficulty, model properties, prompting, and confidence-score distributions are associated with these outcomes.

3 置信度测量和评估Confidence Measurements and Evaluation

我们将语言置信度与内部置信度代理进行比较。对于分类任务，内部代理是对候选答案的基于逻辑的置信度。对于生成任务，内部代理是采样响应的语义熵。We compare linguistic confidence with internal confidence proxies. For classification tasks, the internal proxy is logits-based confidence over the candidate answers. For generation tasks, the internal proxy is semantic entropy over sampled responses.

3.1 语言信心Linguistic Confidence

我们通过要求模型回答任务并报告其自身答案的置信度得分来获得语言置信度We obtain linguistic confidence by asking the model to answer the task and report a confidence score for its own answerGroot and Valdenegro-Toro (2024); Xiong et al. (2023)。提示将 0 定义为不相信答案，10 定义为完全有信心。当与概率进行比较时，我们提取生成的分数并将其除以 10。提示模板详见附录. The prompt defines 0 as no belief in the answer and 10 as full confidence. We extract the generated score and divide it by 10 when comparing it with probabilities. Prompt templates are described in AppendixA.

3.2 内部信心指标Internal Confidence Proxies

对于分类任务，输出格式将答案限制为固定的候选集。我们提取选项标记的 logits 并计算候选集上的 softmax。我们使用所选答案的概率作为基于逻辑的置信度。For classification tasks, output formats constrain the answer to a fixed candidate set. We extract logits for the option tokens and compute a softmax over the candidate set. We use the resulting probability of the selected answer as logits-based confidence.

该数量不应被解释为真实的不确定性。 Softmax 概率可能会被错误校准，并且它们无法捕获每种形式的认知不确定性。在这项工作中，它们充当可以在白盒模型中测量的内部置信代理。因此，这项研究是关于两个可用通道、内部概率信号和语言自我报告之间的保真度。This quantity should not be interpreted as ground-truth uncertainty. Softmax probabilities can be miscalibrated, and they do not capture every form of epistemic uncertainty. In this work, they serve as an internal confidence proxy that can be measured in white-box models. The study is therefore about fidelity between two available channels, internal probability signals and linguistic self-reports.

对于生成任务，关键答案并不总是与一个令牌相关联。因此我们使用语义熵For generation tasks, the key answer is not always tied to one token. We therefore use semantic entropyKuhn et al. (2023)。给出提示. The probability of a semantic cluster is estimated by summing the sequence probabilities of its members,

3.3 评价轴Evaluation Axes

我们沿着三个轴评估置信度对齐。关联性通过 Pearson 相关性和 Spearman 相关性来测量。它捕获两个置信信号在实例中是否沿同一方向变化。将语言置信度映射到后，通过欧几里得距离来测量幅度一致性We evaluate confidence alignment along three axes. Association is measured with Pearson correlation and Spearman correlation. It captures whether two confidence signals vary in the same direction across instances. Magnitude agreement is measured by Euclidean distance after mapping linguistic confidence to[0,1][0,1]。它捕获两个分数的值是否接近。校准是通过预期校准误差 (ECE) 进行测量的. It captures whether the two scores are close in value. Calibration is measured with expected calibration error (ECE)Guo et al. (2017)。它捕获报告的置信度是否与经验准确性相符。. It captures whether reported confidence matches empirical accuracy.

三轴分析直接适用于分类任务，其中基于逻辑的置信度和经验准确性是在同一预测上定义的。对于生成任务，语义熵与语言置信度不在同一概率尺度上，而且自由形式响应的正确性不太统一。因此，我们使用与负语义熵的关联作为生成的主要跨通道度量，并使用距离和 ECE 进行分类设置。The three-axis analysis applies directly to classification tasks, where logits-based confidence and empirical accuracy are defined on the same prediction. For generation tasks, semantic entropy is not on the same probability scale as linguistic confidence and correctness is less uniform across free-form responses. We therefore use association with negated semantic entropy as the primary cross-channel metric for generation, and use distance and ECE for the classification setting.

这些轴回答不同的问题。即使语言置信度系统性过大，相关性也可能很高。当两个分数都集中时，即使两者都不携带太多实例级信息，距离也可能很小。 ECE 衡量正确性的一致性，而不是置信通道之间的一致性。我们联合报告这些指标，以避免将一种形式的协议视为完全可靠。These axes answer different questions. Correlation can be high even when linguistic confidence is systematically too large. Distance can be small when both scores are concentrated, even if neither carries much instance-level information. ECE measures agreement with correctness rather than agreement between confidence channels. We report these metrics jointly to avoid treating one form of agreement as full reliability.

废墟名称Ruin Names是一个异常值。它的准确度相对较低，但语言置信度和基于逻辑的置信度之间的关联度较高。我们避免将此解释为良好的校准。该任务是围绕名称的幽默编辑而建立的，因此即使模型选择了错误的选项，信心也可以跟踪表面熟悉度或拼写相似性。这说明了为什么关联必须与准确性和校准一起阅读。is an outlier. It has relatively low accuracy but high association between linguistic and logits-based confidence. We avoid interpreting this as good calibration. The task is built around humorous edits of names, so confidence may track surface familiarity or orthographic similarity even when the model chooses the wrong option. This shows why association must be read together with accuracy and calibration.

5.3 模型级变化：模型属性影响对齐Model-Level Variation: Model Properties Affect Alignment

我们比较模型配置之间的置信关联。图We compare confidence association across model configurations. Figure3显示了基础模型和指令调整模型的不同缩放趋势。对于基础模型，较大的模型往往具有较高的关联性。对于指令调整模型，关联是平坦的或减少的。shows different scaling trends for base and instruction-tuned models. For base models, larger models tend to have higher association. For instruction-tuned models, association is flat or decreases.

分布解释符合这种模式。较小的基础模型通常会输出集中在 8 或 10 左右的语言置信度，这会留下很少的实例级信号。较大的基础模型会产生更多样的语言置信度，从而可以保留更多的排序信息。相比之下，较大的指令调整模型通常具有接近 1 的基于逻辑的置信度值。这种饱和度减少了内部变化并削弱了与语言置信度的相关性。图A distributional explanation fits this pattern. Smaller base models often output linguistic confidence concentrated around 8 or 10, which leaves little instance-level signal. Larger base models produce more varied linguistic confidence, which can preserve more rank-order information. In contrast, larger instruction-tuned models often have logits-based confidence values near 1. This saturation reduces internal variation and weakens correlation with linguistic confidence. 对于生成任务，我们将语言置信度与否定语义熵进行比较。我们对每个提示采样五个响应，将语义上等效的响应聚类为For generation tasks, we compare linguistic confidence with negated semantic entropy. We sample five responses per prompt, cluster semantically equivalent responses withDeBERTa-xlarge-MNLI He et al. (2021)，计算语义熵并平均采样响应的语言置信度。如节中所述, compute semantic entropy and average the linguistic confidence across the sampled responses. As noted in Section3.3，这些结果是通过关联进行评估的，因为语义熵是一个不确定性分数，而不是语言置信度尺度上的校准概率。, these results are evaluated through association because semantic entropy is an uncertainty score rather than a calibrated probability on the linguistic-confidence scale.

The main pattern is that instruction-tuned models usually show stronger association than their base counterparts on generation tasks. TriviaQA also shows higher association than CoQA. This likely reflects the difference between factoid questions with clearer answers and conversational questions with more context-dependent answer forms. These generation results support the same general conclusion as the classification results. Linguistic confidence can carry some rank-order information, but this does not establish calibrated uncertainty.

5.5 提示级别变化：提示设计主要改变分数分布Prompt-Level Variation: Prompt Design Mainly Changes Score Distributions

我们测试了三个与提示相关的因素。首先，我们搜索少量的置信样本。其次，我们删除信心启发来测试要求信心是否会扰乱逻辑。第三，我们预先考虑态度线索，例如批评、认可和不相关的文字。We test three prompt-related factors. First, we search over few-shot confidence exemplars. Second, we remove confidence elicitation to test whether asking for confidence perturbs logits. Third, we prepend attitude cues such as criticism, approval and irrelevant text.

样本搜索表明置信度样本会影响任务表现和关联。相邻但不相同的分数比相同的分数效果更好。相同的样本往往会破坏所产生的置信分布，从而削弱实例级关联。非常大的样本分数将输出推向高置信度值，并且还减少了有用的变化。这支持了分布式观点，即语言置信度需要足够的传播来保留排名信息。The exemplar search shows that confidence examples affect both task performance and association. Adjacent but non-identical scores work better than identical scores. Identical exemplars tend to collapse the produced confidence distribution, which weakens instance-level association. Very large exemplar scores push outputs toward high confidence values and also reduce useful variation. This supports the distributional view that linguistic confidence needs enough spread to preserve rank information.

消融研究表明，置信度引发不会对内部概率信号产生有意义的干扰。删除置信度查询不会改变准确性，并且对 logits 统计数据的影响有限。对于指令调整模型，没有测试指标发生显着变化。The ablation study shows that confidence elicitation does not meaningfully perturb the internal probability signals. Removing the confidence query does not change accuracy, and it has limited effects on logits statistics. For instruction-tuned models, no tested metric changes significantly.

态度扰动的结果更令人担忧。批评、认可和不相关的线索都会提高报告的语言置信度，但它们会降低与基于逻辑的置信度的关联。要求模型反映最终层概率的校准指令并不能显着改善这种关系。因此，提示音会改变模型听起来的信心程度，但不会使信心更加基于内部概率。完整结果见附录The attitude perturbation results are more concerning. Criticism, approval and irrelevant cues all raise reported linguistic confidence, but they reduce association with logits-based confidence. A calibration instruction asking the model to reflect final-layer probabilities does not significantly improve the relationship. Prompt tone therefore changes how confident the model sounds without making the confidence more grounded in internal probabilities. Full results are in AppendixG.

6 分布属性解释了大部分模式Distributional Properties Explain Much of the Pattern

6.1 回归模型Regression Modeling

我们拟合回归模型来确定哪些变量可以预测置信度对齐。我们对三种结果进行建模。第一个是语言置信度和基于逻辑的置信度之间的相关性，其中越高越好。第二个是两个分数之间的距离，越低越好。第三种是置信度到置信度 ECE，它用 Logits 导出的置信度代替准确度，其中越低越好。对于每个结果，我们将普通最小二乘法和岭回归与标准化特征和五折交叉验证进行拟合。 OLS 系数具有描述性，因为单热编码和相关特征引入了共线性。岭系数用于稳定效果排名。We fit regression models to identify which variables predict confidence alignment. We model three outcomes. The first is the correlation between linguistic and logits-based confidence, where higher is better. The second is the distance between the two scores, where lower is better. The third is a confidence-to-confidence ECE that replaces accuracy with logits-derived confidence, where lower is better. For each outcome, we fit ordinary least squares and ridge regression with standardized features and five-fold cross-validation. OLS coefficients are descriptive because one-hot encodings and correlated features introduce collinearity. Ridge coefficients are used for stable effect ranking.

表Table2显示预测变量共同解释了所有三个结果的很大一部分变化。 OLS 模型达到shows that the predictors jointly account for a substantial fraction of the variation in all three outcomes. The OLS models attainR2R^{2}距离值为 0.570，ECE 式跨通道失配值为 0.644，相关性值为 0.498。values of 0.570 for distance, 0.644 for ECE-style cross-channel mismatch, and 0.498 for correlation.

主要结果是分布统计占主导地位。较大的语言分散度与较高的相关性相关（标准化The main result is that distributional statistics dominate. Larger linguistic dispersion is associated with higher correlation (standardizedβ=0.194\beta=0.194, 非标准化系数的 95% CI, 95% CI for the unstandardized coefficient[0.012,0.070][0.012,0.070], p=0.0058p=0.0058），表明更大的分数变异性可以帮助保留排序信号。相同的色散也与更大的距离相关（标准化), indicating that greater score variability can help preserve rank-order signal. The same dispersion is also associated with greater distance (standardizedβ=0.780\beta=0.780, p<0.001p<0.001）和更高的置信度 ECE（标准化) and higher confidence-to-confidence ECE (standardizedβ=0.318\beta=0.318, p<0.001p<0.001）。因此，色散并不是一个通用的解决方案：它可以改善关联性，同时恶化幅度一致性和跨通道 ECE。语言平均值也有类似的作用。较高的平均置信度与较大的距离相关（标准化). Dispersion is therefore not a universal fix: it can improve association while worsening magnitude agreement and cross-channel ECE. Linguistic mean has a similar role. Higher mean confidence is associated with greater distance (standardizedβ=0.228\beta=0.228, p<0.001p<0.001）和更高的置信度 ECE（标准化) and higher confidence-to-confidence ECE (standardizedβ=0.395\beta=0.395, p<0.001p<0.001），当报告的分数相对于内部代理较高时，与更大的不匹配一致。), consistent with greater mismatch when reported scores are high relative to the internal proxy.

Logits 统计数据也很重要。较高的 logits 平均值与较小的距离和较低的跨通道 ECE 相关，而 logits 离散度也有助于跨通道 ECE。这些效应表明，当内部代理和报告的置信度占据更兼容的范围时，幅度一致性更大；它们不需要将基于逻辑的置信度视为地面实况目标。Logits statistics also matter. Higher logits mean is associated with smaller distance and lower cross-channel ECE, while logits dispersion also contributes to cross-channel ECE. These effects indicate that magnitude agreement is greater when the internal proxy and reported confidence occupy more compatible ranges; they do not require treating logits-based confidence as a ground-truth target.

模型元数据在这些控件之后是次要的。与置信分布统计数据相比，模型类型、系列、版本和大小通常对结果的影响较小且不太一致。模型大小是相关性的部分例外，其岭系数与语言分布系数相当，但这种效应对于距离或跨通道 ECE 不会一致地重复出现。总体而言，结果的重复预测变量是置信分布的属性，而元数据的影响更依赖于特定的结果和模型比较。附录中报告了完整的系数和不确定性估计Model metadata are secondary after these controls. Model type, family, version, and size generally have smaller and less consistent effects across outcomes than the confidence-distribution statistics. Model size is a partial exception for correlation, where its ridge coefficient is comparable to the linguistic-distribution coefficients, but this effect does not recur consistently for distance or cross-channel ECE. Overall, the recurring predictors across outcomes are properties of the confidence distributions, whereas metadata effects are more dependent on the particular outcome and model comparison. Full coefficients and uncertainty estimates are reported in AppendixI.

6.2 有损通道解释A Lossy-Channel Interpretation

这些结果提出了一个简单的解释。语言置信度是从内部置信度到面向用户的分数的有损通道。如果输出通道将许多内部状态映射到相同的语言分数，则该分数无法保留实例级别的区别。当语言置信度在几个高值附近崩溃时，就会发生这种情况。如果通道使用更广泛的分数范围，它可以保留更多的排序信息，从而增加关联性。These results suggest a simple interpretation. Linguistic confidence is a lossy channel from internal confidence to a user-facing score. If the output channel maps many internal states to the same verbal score, the score cannot preserve instance-level distinctions. This occurs when linguistic confidence collapses near a few high values. If the channel uses a broader range of scores, it can preserve more rank-order information, which increases association.

这种解释也解释了为什么分散度不够。更广泛的分数范围仍然可能会向上移动、呈非线性或与正确性匹配不佳。在这种情况下，相关性可能会改善，但校准可能仍然很差。这就是为什么我们不声称增加色散总体上可以改善对准。更准确的说法是，分散可以改善关联性并使置信度对排名或加权有用，但校准仍然需要单独验证。This interpretation also explains why dispersion is not enough. A broader score range can still be shifted upward, be nonlinear, or be poorly matched to correctness. In that case, correlation may improve but calibration can remain poor. This is why we do not claim that increasing dispersion improves alignment in general. The more precise claim is that dispersion can improve association and make confidence useful for ranking or weighting, but calibration still requires separate validation.

7 语言置信度作为加权信号Linguistic Confidence as a Weighting Signal

为了将分析与下游用例联系起来，我们进行了一项小型聚合研究To connect the analysis to a downstream use case, we conduct a small aggregation study withGPT-4.1-纳米gpt-4.1-nano OpenAI (2025)八个分类任务。对于每个提示，我们对 16 个输出进行采样，并通过投票汇总预测。我们比较三种设置。在仅回答投票中，不会引发任何置信度，并且每个预测的权重均为 1。在置信度投票中，模型报告on the eight classification tasks. For each prompt, we sample 16 outputs and aggregate predictions by voting. We compare three settings. In answer-only voting, no confidence is elicited and every prediction has weight 1. In level-confidence voting, the model reports非常有信心Very confident, 有一定的信心Moderately confident, 或, or不确定Uncertain，它们映射到权重 3、2 和 1。在分数置信度投票中，模型报告从 0 到 10 的数字分数。对于每个候选答案，我们将样本之间的权重相加，并选择总权重最高的答案。, which are mapped to weights 3, 2 and 1. In score-confidence voting, the model reports a numeric score from 0 to 10. For each candidate answer, we sum the weights across samples and select the answer with the highest total weight.

表Table3显示置信度加权聚合在此设置中优于多数投票，并且数字置信度表现最佳。我们将此解释为排序信号的说明性下游使用，而不是作为语言置信度经过校准的证据。结果与我们的主要分析是一致的。更多样化的置信分布可以帮助对样本进行加权，但应在部署之前在目标设置上进行验证。shows that confidence-weighted aggregation improves over majority voting in this setting, and numeric confidence performs best. We interpret this as an illustrative downstream use of rank-order signal, not as evidence that linguistic confidence is calibrated. The result is consistent with our main analysis. A more diverse confidence distribution can help weight samples, but it should be validated on the target setting before deployment.

8 操作指导Operational Guidance

实证结果暗示了一个简单的使用策略，如表所示The empirical results imply a simple use policy as shown in Table4。语言置信度首先应被视为待验证的信号，而不是概率。在将其用于弃权、过滤或样本加权之前，应检查报告的分数是否有足够的分散性，它们是否与正确性或保留数据的内部代理相关，以及在其他证据表明不确定性的情况下是否出现高口头信心。. Linguistic confidence should first be treated as a signal to be validated, not as a probability. Before using it for abstention, filtering, or sample weighting, one should check whether the reported scores have enough spread, whether they correlate with correctness or an internal proxy on held-out data, and whether high verbal confidence occurs in cases where other evidence suggests uncertainty.

对于白盒系统，最有用的信号通常是通道之间的不匹配。高语言置信度与低内部置信度相结合，可以识别尽管概率支持较弱但模型听起来很确定的情况。对于黑盒系统，内部置信度不可用，因此更安全的程序是验证同一任务中保留示例的语言置信度。如果报告的分数被折叠或提示敏感，他们不应该控制弃权阈值。如果它们保持分散和有效，它们可以支持弱排名决策，例如置信加权投票。For white-box systems, the most useful signal is often the mismatch between channels. High linguistic confidence paired with low internal confidence identifies cases where the model sounds certain despite weak probability support. For black-box systems, internal confidence is unavailable, so the safer procedure is to validate linguistic confidence on held-out examples from the same task. If reported scores are collapsed or prompt-sensitive, they should not control abstention thresholds. If they remain dispersed and validated, they can support weak ranking decisions such as confidence-weighted voting.

9 讨论Discussion

主要的教训是，语言信心并不是对内部不确定性的透明解读。它是一个独立的置信通道，具有自己的分布行为。在某些制度中，它携带排名顺序信息。在其他情况下，尤其是当分数崩溃到接近高值时，它在实例级别上变得没有信息。这解释了为什么聚合图看起来令人鼓舞，而实例级相关性仍然很弱。The main lesson is that linguistic confidence is not a transparent readout of internal uncertainty. It is a separate confidence channel with its own distributional behavior. In some regimes, it carries rank-order information. In other regimes, especially when scores collapse near high values, it becomes uninformative at the instance level. This explains why aggregate plots can look encouraging while instance-level correlations remain weak.

关联和校准之间的区别是核心。模型可以按照与基于逻辑的置信度相同的方向改变语言置信度，但仍然系统性地过度自信。这种模式经常出现在指令调整模型中。相反，模型可以具有较小的距离，因为两个信号都集中，同时仍然提供很少有用的排名信息。因此，可靠性声明应同时报告关联、幅度一致性和校准。The distinction between association and calibration is central. A model can vary linguistic confidence in the same direction as logits-based confidence and still be systematically overconfident. This pattern appears often for instruction-tuned models. Conversely, a model can have small distance because both signals are concentrated, while still providing little useful ranking information. Reliability claims should therefore report association, magnitude agreement and calibration together.

结果还阐明了即时设计可以做什么和不能做什么。提示可以改变报告置信度的分布，而仔细的范例选择可以避免分数完全崩溃。当信心被用作弱排名信号时，这可能会有所帮助。但提示语气可能会增强信心，但不会改善一致性。要求模型反映其内部概率的提示本身并不会使口头信心跟踪这些概率。The results also clarify what prompt design can and cannot do. Prompting can alter the distribution of reported confidence, and careful exemplar choices can avoid complete score collapse. This may help when confidence is used as a weak ranking signal. But prompt tone can inflate confidence without improving alignment. A prompt that asks the model to reflect its internal probabilities does not by itself make verbal confidence track those probabilities.

我们的分析是诊断性的，而不是因果性的。我们并不声称识别出创建给定置信度分布的训练变化，并且我们也不声称单独操纵方差就能修复置信度。证据表明，通过两个置信通道的均值、方差和饱和度可以更好地理解归因于家族、规模或指令调整的许多对齐模式。这是将语言置信度评估为具有可测量故障模式的通道而不是直接概率估计的主要原因。Our analysis is diagnostic rather than causal. We do not claim to identify the training changes that create a given confidence distribution, and we do not claim that manipulating variance alone will fix confidence. The evidence shows that many alignment patterns attributed to family, size, or instruction tuning are better understood through the mean, variance and saturation of the two confidence channels. This is the main reason to evaluate linguistic confidence as a channel with measurable failure modes, rather than as a direct probability estimate.

10 结论Conclusion

我们研究语言信心是否与法学硕士的内部信心信号一致。在 10 个任务和 30 个模型中，实例级对齐很弱。对于更简单的任务和更强的基础模型，关联往往更高，但指令调整的模型通常仍然过于自信。提示可以改变所报告的置信度分布，但态度提示会增强置信度，而不会改善一致性。回归分析表明，分布特性可以解释大部分观察到的模式。语言色散可以保留排序信号，但它不能保证幅度一致或校准。We study whether linguistic confidence aligns with internal confidence signals in LLMs. Across 10 tasks and 30 models, instance-level alignment is weak. Association tends to be higher on easier tasks and for stronger base models, but instruction-tuned models often remain overconfident. Prompting can change reported confidence distributions, but attitude cues inflate confidence without improving alignment. Regression analyses show that distributional properties explain much of the observed pattern. Linguistic dispersion can preserve rank-order signal, but it does not guarantee magnitude agreement or calibration.

语言信心最好被视为有损信心通道。经过验证后，它对于下游加权很有用，但不应将其视为校准概率。我们建议报告多轴置信度诊断，检查折叠或膨胀的置信度分布，并仅在分布感知验证或保留校准中使用语言置信度。Linguistic confidence is best treated as a lossy confidence channel. It can be useful for downstream weighting when validated, but it should not be treated as a calibrated probability. We recommend reporting multi-axis confidence diagnostics, checking for collapsed or inflated confidence distributions, and using linguistic confidence only with distribution-aware validation or held-out calibration.

局限性Limitations

我们的研究重点是一组有限的开源模型和两个内部置信代理。基于 Logits 的置信度并不是真实的不确定性，语义熵也是对采样和基于 NLI 的聚类等建模选择的估计。我们的目标是比较可用的置信渠道，而不是识别真正的不确定性。Our study focuses on a limited set of open-source models and two internal confidence proxies. Logits-based confidence is not ground-truth uncertainty, and semantic entropy is also an estimate with modeling choices such as sampling and NLI-based clustering. Our goal is to compare available confidence channels, not to identify true uncertainty.

大多数实验都是相关的。回归分析控制了置信均值、方差、任务结构和绩效等可观察因素，但没有建立因果机制。我们也无法获得解释特定模型版本为何改变其置信分布所需的训练细节。Most experiments are correlational. The regression analysis controls for observable factors such as confidence mean, variance, task structure and performance, but it does not establish a causal mechanism. We also do not have access to the training details needed to explain why a particular model version changes its confidence distribution.

重复二次抽样分析减少了人们对主要趋势是特定 200 个示例子集的假象的担忧，但个体估计值仍然存在抽样变异性。黑盒聚合研究规模较小，使用主套件之外的一种模型，无法评估论文的跨渠道诊断；它只能作为说明来阅读。The repeated-subsampling analysis reduces concern that the main trends are artifacts of a particular 200-example subset, but individual estimates still have sampling variability. The black-box aggregation study is small, uses one model outside the main suite, and cannot evaluate the paper’s cross-channel diagnostics; it should be read only as an illustration.

未来的工作应该比较额外的内部不确定性代理，尤其是生成代理，并测试结论在替代代理选择下是否稳定。另一个重要方向是事后置信度激发：首先获得模型的答案，然后要求它评估对已完成答案的置信度。该协议可以揭示反射变化是否表达了置信度，但它需要单独的生成设置，并且超出了当前实验的范围。Future work should compare additional internal uncertainty proxies, especially for generation, and test whether conclusions are stable under alternative proxy choices. Another important direction is post-hoc confidence elicitation: first obtain the model’s answer, then ask it to assess confidence in that completed answer. This protocol may reveal whether reflection changes expressed confidence, but it requires a separate generation setting and is outside the scope of the present experiments.

道德考虑Ethical Considerations

这项工作研究了法学硕士面向用户的信心陈述何时可能产生误导。主要的道德风险是置信度分数可能会产生不必要的信任，尤其是在用户无法检查内部不确定性信号的环境中。我们的结果表明，除非已针对特定任务和部署环境进行了验证，否则不应将高语言置信度表示为校准概率。This work studies when user-facing confidence statements from LLMs can be misleading. The main ethical risk is that confidence scores may create unwarranted trust, especially in settings where users cannot inspect internal uncertainty signals. Our results suggest that high linguistic confidence should not be presented as a calibrated probability unless it has been validated for the specific task and deployment context.

该研究使用现有的 NLP 基准和公开可用的模型，没有收集人类受试者的数据。这些实用建议旨在通过鼓励多轴报告、不匹配检测和保留校准来减少对无支持的置信声明的过度依赖。然而，如果这些诊断作为可靠性的保证，也可能被滥用。因此，我们警告不要使用语言置信度作为高风险应用中决策的唯一依据。The study uses existing NLP benchmarks and publicly available models, with no human-subject data collection. The practical recommendations are intended to reduce overreliance on unsupported confidence claims by encouraging multi-axis reporting, mismatch detection and held-out calibration. However, these diagnostics can also be misused if presented as guarantees of reliability. We therefore caution against using linguistic confidence as the sole basis for decisions in high-stakes applications.

We describe the confidence elicitation prompts used for both classification and generation tasks, followed by analyses of prompt sensitivity, including few-shot confidence exemplar search, confidence-elicitation ablation, and attitude-based prompt perturbations.

A.2 生成提示设计Generation Prompt Design

对于生成任务，我们按照提示设置For generation tasks, we follow the prompting setup ofKuhn et al. (2023)并在后面附加语言置信度诱导说明and append linguistic confidence elicitation instructions followingXiong et al. (2023)。我们评估两个具有代表性的生成基准，. We evaluate two representative generation benchmarks,辅酶QACoQA和and问答问答TriviaQA.

对于 CoQA，每个实例都由一个上下文段落和几个问答对组成，我们采用零样本提示设置。对于 TriviaQA，我们采用十次提示策略来提高响应准确性。在这两种设置中，语言置信度都是与生成的响应一起得出的，并在用于语义熵估计的五个采样代中进行平均。For CoQA, each instance consists of a context paragraph and several question-answer pairs, where we adopt a zero-shot prompting setup. For TriviaQA, we employ a ten-shot prompting strategy to improve response accuracy. In both settings, linguistic confidence is elicited alongside generated responses and averaged across the five sampled generations used for semantic-entropy estimation.

A.3 信心激发消融Confidence-Elicitation Ablation

为了检查置信度引发本身是否会扰乱内部概率分布，我们进行了消融实验，删除了语言置信度指令，同时保持所有其他提示设置不变。对于基本模型，我们保留原始的两次样本示例，而无需置信度诱导，而指令调整模型则保留相同的格式约束。To examine whether confidence elicitation itself perturbs internal probability distributions, we conduct ablation experiments removing linguistic confidence instructions while keeping all other prompt settings unchanged. For base models, we retain the original two-shot examples without confidence elicitation, while instruction-tuned models preserve the same formatting constraints.

A.4 基于态度的即时扰动Attitude-Based Prompt Perturbation

为了调查用户态度是否影响报告的信心，我们在原始任务提示之前预先添加批评、认可和不相关的提示。每个态度类别包含三个提示变体。这些扰动旨在测试语言置信度是否反映了潜在的模型不确定性或对对话框架敏感。To investigate whether user attitude affects reported confidence, we prepend criticism, approval, and irrelevant cues before the original task prompt. Each attitude category contains three cue variants. These perturbations are designed to test whether linguistic confidence reflects underlying model uncertainty or is sensitive to conversational framing.

附录BAppendix B数据集稳定性分析Dataset Stability Analysis

下采样仅用于计算的易处理性。为了测试 200 个示例的限制是否会系统地改变结果，我们为五个受影响的任务构建了更大的评估池，并评估了每个任务完成的九个模型提示设置。对于 CoLA 和时间序列，我们使用完整的评估集；对于 QNLI 和 MMLU，我们使用大幅扩大的评估池。由于 QQP 评估集相当大且全面评估成本高昂，因此我们随机抽取了 5,000 个示例作为稳定性分析的完整代理集。对于每个任务和设置，我们从相应的较大池中抽取 200 个示例的 500 个随机子样本，并重新计算准确度、归一化准确度、Pearson、Spearman 和 Kendall 相关性、ECE 和跨通道距离。确切的主要论文子集、QQP 代理集和重采样代码都包含在已发布的存储库中。Downsampling is used for computational tractability only. To test whether the 200-example limit systematically changes the results, we construct larger evaluation pools for the five affected tasks and evaluate nine model–prompt settings completed for every task. For CoLA and Temporal Sequences, we use the full evaluation sets; for QNLI and MMLU, we use substantially enlarged evaluation pools. Because the QQP evaluation set is considerably larger and expensive to evaluate in full, we randomly sample 5,000 examples as a proxy full set for the stability analysis. For each task and setting, we draw 500 random subsamples of 200 examples from the corresponding larger pool and recompute accuracy, normalized accuracy, Pearson, Spearman, and Kendall correlations, ECE, and cross-channel distance. The exact main-paper subsets, the QQP proxy set, and the resampling code are included in the released repository.

在各个任务中，子样本估计值与其相应的较大池估计值之间的中值绝对差异为 0.024–0.027，并且 93.9%–95.3% 的估计值落在Across tasks, the median absolute difference between a subsample estimate and its corresponding larger-pool estimate is 0.024–0.027, and 93.9%–95.3% of estimates fall within±0.10\pm 0.10。对于总体 585 个指标行中的 581 行以及涉及与我们的结论最直接相关的五个指标的所有 225 行，较大池估计值落在子采样分布的 95% 区间内。因此，200 个示例的评估恢复了在较大评估池中观察到的趋势，没有可检测到的系统失真，尽管个体估计保留了抽样变异性。. The larger-pool estimate falls within the 95% interval of the subsampling distribution for 581 of 585 metric rows overall and for all 225 rows involving the five metrics most directly tied to our conclusions. Thus, the 200-example evaluations recover the trends observed in the larger evaluation pools without detectable systematic distortion, although individual estimates retain sampling variability.

我们分析了模型更新对语言置信度分布特性的影响，发现分散度在确定对齐方面起着核心作用。具体来说，语言置信度标准差从We analyze the effect of model updates on the distributional properties of linguistic confidence and find that dispersion plays a central role in determining alignment. Specifically, linguistic-confidence standard deviation increases from1.161.16 to 1.321.32适用于 8B Llama 基础型号。相比之下，Qwen3 相对于 Qwen2.5 表现出显着的离差崩溃，标准差从for the 8B Llama base models. In contrast, Qwen3 exhibits a substantial collapse in dispersion relative to Qwen2.5, with standard deviation decreasing from1.231.23 to 0.710.71对于 14B 基本型号。这种对比与它们不同的相关趋势相一致，其中 LLaMA 模型显示出更好的一致性，而 Qwen 模型则表现出退化。较高的分散度可以保留实例级排名信息，而压缩的分布会降低表达性并削弱关联性。虽然我们没有做出因果关系，但这些差异可能与模型更新中训练和训练后目标的更广泛变化有关。例如，LLaMA3.1引入了数据比例和对齐程序的变化for the 14B base models. This contrast aligns with their divergent correlation trends, where LLaMA models show improved alignment and Qwen models degrade. Higher dispersion can preserve instance-level rank information, whereas compressed distributions reduce expressivity and weaken association. While we do not make causal claims, these differences may be related to broader shifts in training and post-training objectives across model updates. For example, LLaMA3.1 introduces changes in data scale and alignment proceduresGrattafiori et al. (2024)，而 Qwen3 等较新的模型则越来越强调推理和结构化生成, while newer models such as Qwen3 place increasing emphasis on reasoning and structured generationYang et al. (2025)。这些变化可能会影响信心在语言中的表达方式，并可能影响其传播。然而，在训练策略和置信度分布之间建立直接的因果关系仍然是未来工作的重要方向。这些结果表明模型同一性本身并不能解释对齐。置信度分数的分布变化占了观察到的模式的大部分。. Such changes may influence how confidence is expressed in language, potentially affecting its dispersion. However, establishing a direct causal link between training strategies and confidence distribution remains an important direction for future work. These results suggest that model identity alone does not explain alignment. Distributional changes in the confidence scores account for much of the observed pattern.

G.2 消融研究Ablation Studies

我们测试引发语言置信度是否会扰乱最后层的逻辑。对于每个模型和所有八个任务，我们在不要求置信度的情况下重复主要设置，并保持所有其他设置固定。对于基本模型，每个提示仍包含两个上下文中的 QA 示例。代表性提示如图所示We test whether eliciting linguistic confidence perturbs final-layer logits. For every model and all eight tasks, we repeat the main setup without requesting confidence, holding all other settings fixed. For base models, each prompt still contains two in-context QA exemplars. Representative prompts are shown in Figures11和and12。表中报告了归一化准确度、平均 Logits、Logits 方差和 ECE 的配对比较. Paired comparisons of normalized accuracy, average logits, logits variance, and ECE are reported in Table9.

如表所示As shown in Table9，删除置信度启发会使归一化准确率保持不变。然而，对于基础模型，它会在平均 Logits 和 Logits 方差以及 Logits ECE 方面产生微小但统计上显着的变化。对于指令调整模型，测试的指标没有显着变化。因此，置信度启发不会影响我们实验中的任务准确性，但它会适度扰乱基本模型的内部概率分布。, removing confidence elicitation leaves normalized accuracy unchanged. For base models, however, it produces small but statistically significant shifts in average logits and logits variance and, in one comparison, in logits ECE. For instruction-tuned models, none of the tested metrics changes significantly. Thus, confidence elicitation does not affect task accuracy in our experiments, but it can modestly perturb internal probability distributions for base models.

G.3 即时扰动Prompt Perturbation

为了测试对用户态度的敏感性，我们预先添加了表达批评、认可或无关紧要的简短提示。每种态度都使用在主要 QA 示例之前插入的三个变体。我们评估了三种不同模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Llama-3.1-8B）上的八项任务以及态度类型的平均值。我们还包括一个校准变体，附加“确保您报告的置信度反映了最终层 logits 的 softmax 概率”。提示集如图所示To test sensitivity to user attitude, we prepend short cues that convey criticism, approval, or irrelevance. Each attitude uses three variants inserted before the main QA examples. We evaluate eight tasks on three diverse models (Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Llama-3.1-8B) and average within attitude type. We also include a calibration variant that appends “Make sure the confidence you report reflects the softmax probabilities from your final-layer logits.” The cue sets are listed in Figure13（附录(AppendixA）。结果显示在表中). Results appear in Table10.

如表所示As shown in Table10，态度线索不断提高报告的语言信心。认可的效果最大，批评也是积极的，甚至不相关的线索也会增加平均值。与此同时，与 logits 的关联性下降，这表明报告的信心膨胀并非基于内部概率。校准指令不会显着改变平均置信度或相关性。总体而言，提示语气会增强所表达的信心并削弱其与内部概率的关联。, attitude cues consistently raise reported linguistic confidence. Approval has the largest effect, criticism is also positive, and even irrelevant cues increase averages. At the same time, the association with logits decreases, which indicates that inflation in reported confidence is not grounded in internal probabilities. The calibration instruction does not significantly change either average confidence or correlation. Overall, prompt tone can inflate stated confidence and weaken its association with internal probabilities.

与基于对数的置信度不同，它直接反映了模型在标记上的内部概率分布，Unlike logits-based confidence, which directly reflects the model’s internal probability distribution over tokens,语义熵semantic entropy旨在捕获生成任务中的不确定性，其中确切的答案范围或关键标记位置很难查明。它衡量生成的响应在语义上的多样性，而不是令牌级别概率出现的峰值程度。为了进一步说明这两种不确定性度量之间的区别，我们还比较了几个分类任务上基于逻辑的置信度和语义熵，详见附录is designed to capture uncertainty in generative tasks where the exact answer span or key token positions are difficult to pinpoint. It measures how semantically diverse the generated responses are rather than how peaked the token-level probabilities appear. To further illustrate the distinction between these two uncertainty measures, we also compare logits-based confidence and semantic entropy on several classification tasks, as detailed in AppendixH.3.

H.3 语义熵和基于 Logits 的置信度Semantic Entropy and Logits-Based Confidence

与直接反映标记级概率分布的基于逻辑的置信度不同，语义熵捕获生成设置中的不确定性，在生成设置中，难以识别准确的答案范围或显着标记位置。它通过生成的响应之间的语义多样性而不是令牌上的概率集中来量化不确定性。Unlike logits-based confidence, which directly reflects token-level probability distributions, semantic entropy captures uncertainty in generative settings where exact answer spans or salient token positions are difficult to identify. It quantifies uncertainty through semantic diversity among generated responses rather than probability concentration over tokens.

为了进一步说明这些不确定性度量之间的区别，我们还比较了几个分类任务上基于逻辑的置信度和语义熵。To further illustrate the distinction between these uncertainty measures, we additionally compare logits-based confidence and semantic entropy on several classification tasks.
